ATTENTION: Mr. Henry M. Yamanaka Mobility Studies Engineer Mobility Studies Re: Lincoln Highway Improvement Cicero Ave. to Chicago Rd. Dear Mr. Yamanaka: This is in response to your letter of January 10, 1972. It will also advise that the City of Chicago Heights has agreed with School District No. 170 to adopt Scheme A, dated April 27, 1971, which accompanied your letter of July 8, 1971, addressed to Mayor George R. Bonick. This will also confirm our understanding of the matters cortained in your letter of January 10, 1972. Should you need any additional documentation please do not hesitate to call on me. Very truly yours, CITY OF CHICAGO HEIGHTS Trava A. Shruart. FRANK E. GLOWACKI Corporation Counsel FEG:CW Mr. Charles N. Rellis B - 17
